hero.heading: Hello!
hero.desc: I am Amruta. I am an urban planner and spatial researcher, and I love working on cities using data and through discussion. I share here my experiments and exploration with spatial data.

footer.subtitle: Experiments with urban data, mapping and GIS tools

heatwave.title: Public places in Paris during heatwave – hot or not?
heatwave.desc: As Paris entered its third heatwave of the summer, how do the city’s public spaces perform under extreme temperatures? A look at land surface temperature across parks, plazas, and streets.

velib.title: Checking the pulse of Paris with Vélib’
velib.desc: Analysing the temporal rhythms of Paris through Vélib’ bike-sharing data – exploring morning and evening peaks, weekend patterns, and station-level activity across the city.

landscape.title: Landscape Pattern Analysis: What data type works better?
landscape.desc: Comparing vector and raster data types for landscape connectivity analysis using morphological spatial pattern analysis (MSPA) in the Lisbon metropolitan area.

eiffel.title: Streets with Tour Eiffel
eiffel.desc: A viewshed analysis to identify from which streets in Paris one can spot the Eiffel Tower, using DEM, building heights, and tree canopy data.

urban.title: Mapping urban health and vulnerability
urban.desc: An urban health index and vulnerability index for Ferrara, Italy, using open data to understand the relationship between built environment quality and socio-demographic vulnerability at the census tract level.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.desc: Research, academic and professional projects from 2017 to 2021.
